messages:
raul_ap: Invoice INV-LW-478 from LucidWave hit AP with NO PO and shows a 10% early-pay discount. Vendor accounts@lucidwave.ai put 'PO: pending' on the PDF. System routed to Legal for contract review instead of Finance. Can procurement confirm whether a PO should exist?
mira_procure: We have SOW LW-SOW-2025-04 but procurement didn't issue a PO because vendor requested invoicing against SOW. Our policy requires a PO for amounts > $5k. This invoice is $28,600. Should have had PO.
clairе_legal: (typo) Claire_legal: I'll need to validate whether the SOW contains vendor's billing terms and early-pay discount clause. If invoicing against SOW is allowed, we can create a post-facto PO or approve without PO with Legal sign-off.
devon_sales: LucidWave is a strategic partner; they offered a 10% net-15 discount for Q3 pilot. Sales approved verbally. We can confirm in the Slack DM thread with their AM.
vendor-bot: LucidWave (accounts@lucidwave.ai) uploaded INV-LW-478 (PDF)  link: https://files.example.com/lucidwave/INV-LW-478.pdf
raul_ap: AP blocked due to missing PO and vendor name mismatch: invoice company is 'Lucid Wave Ltd' while vendor master is 'LucidWave Inc'. That prevented auto-match.
mira_procure: Likely a UK subsidiary vs US parent issue. Procurement can add a vendor alias if legal approves. Claire, can Legal confirm acceptable payee?
clairе_legal: Will review SOW & vendor IDs. Quick check: need VAT reg and W-8/W-9 as applicable. Also confirm whether subsidiary invoice is payable under our master agreement. I'll take it.
finance-bot: Automation: flagged 'legal_review_required' and created ticket T-11422. Audit note added.
devon_sales: I asked AM; they replied: "Invoice issued by Lucid Wave Ltd (UK entity) per local billing. They confirm services under Master Agreement MA-77. No PO issued at time of work. Early-pay discount valid"
raul_ap: If Legal signs off, procurement create PO-LW-2025-04 (post-facto) and AP can match. Also need vendor alias linking Lucid Wave Ltd -> LucidWave Inc in vendor master.
mira_procure: I'll prepare PO-LW-2025-04 draft and vendor alias request. Do we need supplier tax docs before creating alias?
clairе_legal: Yes please attach vendor VAT and beneficial owner docs. If UK entity is confirmed and SOW covers work, Legal will approve alias. Expect decision by EOD.
raul_ap: For now payment_hold:true. Added note: "hold until legal confirms and PO created; early-pay discount honored if payment within net-15 after approval".
finance-bot: Payment team notified of hold. Next update when Legal closes T-11422.
clairе_legal: Done — reviewed MA-77, confirmed UK entity is permitted invoice recipient. Attached vendor VAT GB987654321. Legal approves post-facto PO.
mira_procure: PO created PO-LW-2025-04, alias linked. AP re-run match.
finance-bot: Match succeeded. Invoice mapped to PO-LW-2025-04, GL 6201 (professional services). Early-pay discount flagged, payment window adjusted. Marking ticket closed.
raul_ap: Approved and scheduling for accelerated payment to capture 10% discount. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
